title: Check the BAS worksheet
summary: How to see G1, 1A and 1B for a quarter, and the GST to pay or be refunded.

steps.text: Click Reports, then BAS worksheet. It opens on last quarter.

image.description: The BAS worksheet with sample data for July to September 2026: G1 total sales including GST, 1A GST on sales, 1B GST on purchases, and GST to pay, with a note that the app does not lodge anything with the ATO.

steps.text: Click a figure to see every line in it. A line that looks wrong is fixed in Transactions, and the worksheet changes with it.
Export a PDF for your records, or for your accountant.

sections.heading: What it does not do
paragraphs: This worksheet is for you or your accountant to fill in the BAS. The app does not lodge anything with the ATO.
It is the simpler BAS, on the basis set for the business. Ask your accountant if you are not sure which labels apply to you.
